units.source_text: 薰中将就去访问八亲王。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Captain, went to visit the Eighth Prince.

units.source_text: 他邀集几个爱好音乐的人同去。

en.t: He invited several music lovers to go with him.

units.source_text: 渡河之时，船中奏《酣醉乐》。

en.t: As they crossed the river, Kansuiraku was played in the boat.

units.source_text: 八亲王的山庄临水筑着回廊，廊中有石阶梯通向水面，富有山乡风趣，真是一所极有意思的山庄。

en.t: The Eighth Prince's mountain villa had a gallery built beside the water, with stone steps leading from the corridor down to the surface, giving it a rustic mountain charm; it was truly a most interesting retreat.

units.source_text: 诸人都怀着恭谨的心情舍舟登陆。

en.t: Everyone left the boat and came ashore in a mood of respectful reverence.

units.source_text: 室内光景也和别处不同：山乡式竹帘屏风，非常简单朴素；各种陈设布置，也都别有风味。

en.t: The interior, too, was unlike other places: the mountain-style bamboo blinds and screens were extremely simple and plain, and every furnishing and arrangement had its own distinctive charm.

units.source_text: 今天准备招待远客，打扫得特别干净。

en.t: Because distant guests were to be entertained that day, everything had been cleaned with special care.

units.source_text: 几种音色优美无比的古乐器，随意不拘地陈列着。

en.t: Several old instruments of unsurpassed beauty of tone were set out in an easy, unceremonious way.

units.source_text: 大家逐一弹奏，将双调催马乐《樱人》改弹为壹越调。

en.t: They played them one after another, adapting the saibara song Sakurabito from the sojo mode into the ichikotsu mode.

units.source_text: 诸客都希望乘此机会听听主人八亲王的七弦琴。

en.t: All the guests hoped to take this chance to hear their host, the Eighth Prince, play the seven-stringed kin.

units.source_text: 但八亲王只管弹筝，无心无思地、断断续续地和人合奏。

en.t: But the Eighth Prince merely kept playing the koto, joining the others only absentmindedly and in broken snatches.

units.source_text: 大约是不曾听惯之故，似觉他的琴声非常奥妙优美，诸青年人都很感动。

en.t: Perhaps because they were not used to hearing it, his playing seemed profoundly subtle and beautiful, and all the young men were deeply moved.

units.source_text: 八亲王安排山乡式的筵席款待来客，很有情趣。

en.t: The Eighth Prince entertained his guests with a mountain-village-style banquet, full of quiet charm.

units.source_text: 更有外人所预想不到的：有许多出身并不低微的王子王孙，例如年老的四位王族之类的人，想是预先顾念到八亲王家招待这班贵宾缺乏人手，都来帮忙。

en.t: There was something else outsiders would never have expected: many princes and royal descendants of no low birth, including such people as four elderly members of the imperial family, had apparently foreseen that the Eighth Prince's household would lack hands to receive these distinguished guests, and had all come to help.

units.source_text: 奉觞进酒的人，个个衣冠楚楚。

en.t: Those who presented cups and offered wine were all impeccably dressed.

units.source_text: 这正是乡土方式的古风盛宴。

en.t: It was truly an old-fashioned feast in the country manner.

units.source_text: 来客之中，定有想象住在这里的女公子的生活状况而私下为她们伤心的人吧。

en.t: Among the guests there must have been some who imagined the lives of the young ladies dwelling here and secretly grieved for them.

units.source_text: 尤其是留在对岸的匂皇子，由于自己身份所关，不能随便行动，竟感到非常苦闷。

en.t: Prince Niou in particular, left on the opposite bank and unable to act freely because of his rank, felt terribly distressed.

units.source_text: 他觉得这机会总不可错过，忍耐不住，便命人折取一枝美丽的樱花，差一个相貌姣好的随身殿上童子，送一封信去。

en.t: Feeling that he absolutely must not let this chance slip by, he could no longer restrain himself; he had someone break off a beautiful branch of cherry blossom and sent a handsome young page of his household to deliver a letter.

units.source_text: 信中写道：

en.t: The letter said:
